key_points: Q2 earnings beat and 2026 profit outlook raised, driving an 8% after‑hours rally
Cox Automotive projects Q3 US sales down ~7% and Hyundai to outsell Ford, pressuring market share
Stock fell 2‑3% on the same day as sales outlook, indicating mixed short‑term reaction
Ford announced a $1 billion Kentucky paint‑shop investment amid political scrutiny, a neutral‑to‑positive capital‑expenditure signal
Trefis notes Ford’s strong cash generation, supporting a longer‑term cash‑flow thesis
